从三个开源库,到 224G 的架构决策工具From three open-source libraries to a 224G architecture decision tool

一个覆盖 NRZ(≤32G)与 PAM4(≤224G)、mixed-signal 与 ADC-based 双接收机架构的仿真框架;以及在其上完成的一整轮架构探索——量化了从 C2M 到深 LR、每个杠杆值多少 dB、各花什么代价。A framework spanning NRZ (≤32G) and PAM4 (≤224G), both mixed-signal and ADC-based receivers — and a full round of architecture exploration on top of it, quantifying the path from C2M to deep long-reach: how many dB each lever buys, and what each one costs.

缘起:三个开源库Origin: three reference libraries

serdespy · Stanford DragonPHY2 · PyBERTserdespy · Stanford DragonPHY2 · PyBERT

项目从对三个开源 SerDes 项目的逐文件深度分析开始,它们恰好覆盖"算法 → 仿真器 → 硅实现"三个层次,构成自研框架的蓝本。The project began with a file-by-file analysis of three open-source SerDes projects that happen to span three layers — algorithm, simulator, silicon — forming the blueprint for the framework.

Algorithm
serdespy
多伦多大学 Carusone 组。最小可读的全链路实现:混模转换、零迫 FFE、LMS、KP4/KR4。教学级,无测试、有 bug——作蓝本不作依赖。Carusone group, U of Toronto. Minimal readable full-link implementation: mixed-mode conversion, ZF-FFE, LMS, KP4/KR4. Teaching-grade — a blueprint, not a dependency.
Silicon RTL
DragonPHY2
Stanford VLSI。ADC-based 接收机的可流片 RTL:并行 FFE、MM-CDR、滑动检测器(简化 MLSD),以及"Python 黄金模型 ↔ RTL 逐点 lockstep"的验证方法学。Stanford VLSI. Tape-out RTL for an ADC-based RX: parallel FFE, MM-CDR, sliding detector (simplified MLSD), and a "Python golden model ↔ RTL lockstep" methodology.
Simulator
PyBERT
David Banas,12 年演进。S 参数处理、抖动分解、IBIS-AMI、COM——行为级仿真最扎实的实战参考,但架构是 God-object。David Banas, 12 years. S-parameter handling, jitter decomposition, IBIS-AMI, COM — the most battle-tested behavioral reference, though a God-object architecture.
调研即已发现Found during the survey
在复现 serdespy 的黄金数据时,数值上确认了它两个未公开的实现瑕疵:端接参考阻抗单端/差分混用,以及端口置换不完整。这些在自研框架里都做对了,并写进了分析文档。 While reproducing serdespy's golden data, two undocumented quirks were numerically confirmed: single-ended vs differential termination-reference mixing, and an incomplete port permutation. Both are handled correctly in the framework and documented.

02

探索一:mixed-signal 架构的边界Exploration I: the mixed-signal envelope

传统 mixed-signal 接收机——CTLE + DFE + bang-bang CDR,判决器之前必须在模拟域把眼打开。我们完整走了它的链路、眼图、自适应、时钟恢复,并摸清了它的速率上限。The traditional mixed-signal RX — CTLE + DFE + bang-bang CDR — must open the eye in the analog domain before the slicer. We walked its full link, eyes, adaptation, clock recovery, and mapped its rate ceiling.

均衡后的眼图:模拟域打开Post-EQ eyes: opened in the analog domain

-32 dB 信道下均衡前眼图完全闭合(左),FFE 后张开,FFE+DFE 后采样时刻内眼 6.8 mV。DFE 眼在 ±0.5 UI 处的阶梯不连续,是反馈按 UI 边界切换的标志性形状。Under −32 dB the pre-EQ eye is fully closed (left); FFE opens it; after FFE+DFE the inner eye is 6.8 mV at the sampling instant. The staircase discontinuity at ±0.5 UI is the signature of UI-boundary feedback switching.

产品级分工:接收机里没有 FFEProduct partition: no FFE in the receiver

一个关键修正:产品级 mixed-signal 接收机不含 RX FFE。线性均衡分工是 Tx FIR(backchannel 训练)+ RX CTLE + RX DFE。多抽头 RX FFE 只在 ADC 架构里才是真实电路。框架据此把静态链路的 FFE 明确标为"链路总均衡预算"而非 RX 模块,并实现了 KR 式 backchannel Tx 训练(RX 测光标 → 发 inc/dec 请求)。A key correction: a product mixed-signal RX carries no RX FFE. The linear-EQ split is Tx FIR (backchannel-trained) + RX CTLE + RX DFE; many-tap RX FFE is real only in the ADC architecture. The framework labels the static-link FFE as the link's total EQ budget, not an RX block, and implements KR-style backchannel Tx training.

速率上限:~30 GBd 撞墙Rate ceiling: the wall at ~30 GBd

据此把产品级 mixed-signal 包络定为三层结构,并作为框架默认:This calibrated a three-tier mixed-signal envelope, wired in as the framework default:

30 GBd 硬顶代表本模型未建模的电路墙:CTLE 增益带宽、判决器孔径、时钟分发抖动——真实 mixed-signal 正是在此撞墙。The 30 GBd ceiling stands for the circuit walls this behavioral model omits — CTLE gain-bandwidth, slicer aperture, clock-path jitter — where real mixed-signal designs stop.

自适应与时钟恢复的动态Adaptation & clock-recovery dynamics

过程中挖出的真 bugA real bug, uncovered here
慢方向(-200 ppm)频偏最初完全不跟踪。逐层排查定位到 jittered_zoh 波形生成器:边界区域按名义网格回填,累计时移超过 1 UI 时被静默削平。重写为按实际相邻边界顺序填充后修复,并把频偏测试参数化成双向——单向测试正是当初漏掉它的原因。 The slow direction (−200 ppm) initially failed to track. Layer-by-layer debugging pinned it to the jittered_zoh generator: region refills used nominal grid positions, silently clipping cumulative shifts beyond 1 UI. Rewritten as sequential interval fill; the frequency test is now bidirectional — a one-sided test was why it was missed.
方法论教训Methodology lesson
锁定检测不能用 PD 均值或周期均值——牵引期的乱码判决会让二者都≈标称值,骗过判据;必须用相位平稳性(滑窗峰峰值)。类似地,眼高必须按真实发送符号分组量测,按阈值分组数学上恒为正、永远测不出闭眼。"不可证伪的指标"要警惕。 Lock detection can't use PD-mean or period-mean — garbage decisions during pull-in fool both toward nominal; phase stationarity is needed. Likewise eye height must be grouped by the true transmitted symbol; grouping by measured value against thresholds is ≥0 by construction and can never detect a closed eye. Beware unfalsifiable metrics.
03

探索二:ADC-based 架构Exploration II: the ADC-based RX

56G 之后的架构:轻 CTLE + 时间交织 ADC + 数字 FFE/DFE/MLSD + Mueller-Müller CDR。均衡负担从模拟域整体搬到数字域。10⁶ 符号仿真仅需 7 秒。The post-56G architecture: light CTLE + time-interleaved ADC + digital FFE/DFE/MLSD + Mueller-Müller CDR. The equalization burden moves wholesale from analog to digital. 10⁶-symbol runs in 7 s.

眼图在哪里?——闭在模拟,开在数字Where is the eye? Closed in analog, open in digital

这就是 ADC 架构的存在理由This is the whole rationale for ADC receivers
224G 那一行:眼在 ADC 输入处完全闭合,在数字域被重新打开。所以 CTLE 只需 1.5 dB 轻均衡,而 mixed-signal 要 8.6 dB 在判决器前撑开眼。这也是为什么 ADC 架构的主指标是 slicer SNR/SER 而非眼高——DSP 域只有离散采样点。 The 224G row: the eye is fully closed at the ADC input and reopened digitally. Hence the CTLE needs only 1.5 dB, versus mixed-signal's 8.6 dB to force the eye open before the slicer — and why the ADC architecture's primary metrics are slicer SNR/SER, not eye height.
04

探索三:深 LR 的三个杠杆Exploration III: three levers for deep long-reach

前面的 224G demo 是 -18 dB 的 C2M 温和信道。真实 802.3dj 长距是 35-45 dB。我们逐一加码,量化每个杠杆值多少 dB——并发现它们作用在正交的环节上,可以叠加。The earlier 224G demos used a benign −18 dB C2M channel. Real 802.3dj long-reach is 35-45 dB. We added each measure in turn, quantifying its dB — and found the levers act on orthogonal parts of the budget, so they stack.

杠杆一:MLSD 只拿回短 FFE 留下的 ISILever 1 — MLSD only recovers what a short FFE leaves

FFE 强行反演信道会放大噪声;DFE 有错误传播。MLSD(Viterbi 序列检测)在残余 ISI 上给出序列增益、无错误传播。重跑后 21 抽头 FFE 到 −28.8 dB 零误码,残余光标 ≤ 0.002,memory-2 MLSD 在每个损耗都是 1.0×;原先"−27 dB 处 29× 增益"来自 CDR 锁偏。换成 3 抽头 FFE,它留下 h2 ≈ −0.05…−0.11,MLSD 拿回 1.9–4.4×,但仍不如 21 抽头 FFE 单独用。要 MLSD 真加 reach,FFE 得均衡到部分响应目标(1+αD),这一项未建模。FFE-inverting the channel enhances noise; DFE propagates errors. MLSD (Viterbi) gives sequence gain on the residual ISI with no error propagation. Rerun: a 21-tap FFE is error-free to −28.8 dB with residual cursors of 0.002 or less, and memory-2 MLSD is 1.0× at every loss; the old "29× at −27 dB" came from the CDR's off-peak lock. With a 3-tap FFE the residual h2 is −0.05…−0.11 and MLSD recovers 1.9–4.4×, still short of the 21-tap FFE alone. For MLSD to add reach the FFE must equalise to a partial-response target (1+αD), which is not modelled.

杠杆二 vs 杠杆三:DSP 深度 vs ADC 质量Lever 2 vs 3 — DSP depth vs ADC quality

加 DFE + 更深 MLSD(memory-3)只多 0.8 dB——因为到这里残余 ISI 已小,链路是 SNR 受限,不是 ISI 受限。真正的大杠杆是 ADC 采样质量:ENOB 6.5→7.5、噪声减半,同 DSP 多 5.3 dB。Adding DFE + deeper MLSD (memory-3) buys only 0.8 dB — the residual ISI is already small and the link is SNR-limited, not ISI-limited. The real lever is ADC sampling quality: ENOB 6.5→7.5 with half the noise buys 5.3 dB with the same DSP.

杠杆四:级联内码 FECLever 4 — concatenated inner-code FEC

内码先纠一轮,把 RS-KP4 外码看到的错误率压低,等效把可容忍的 pre-FEC BER 从 2.2e-4 抬到 ~7e-3(31 倍)。BCH(255,215) 内码使 reach 从 32.4 到 36.2 dB——纯靠 FEC,不动 DSP/ADC,代价是开销从 6% 涨到 24%。An inner code corrects most raw errors, so the RS-KP4 outer sees a far lower rate — raising the tolerable pre-FEC BER from 2.2e-4 to ~7e-3 (31×). A BCH(255,215) inner extends reach from 32.4 to 36.2 dB, from the code side alone, at overhead rising from 6% to 24%.

架构决策图景The architecture decision picture

整条速率轴上,架构选择由符号率(不是数据率)决定,因为 mixed-signal 的瓶颈在模拟带宽/时序,按 UI 算。Across the rate axis, architecture is chosen by symbol rate (not data rate): the mixed-signal bottleneck is analog bandwidth/timing, which scales with UI.

核心论点The thesis
深 LR 是全栈问题,没有单一杠杆能到。每个杠杆单独到顶都会撞上各自的墙——DSP 撞 SNR 墙、FEC 撞 pre-FEC 悬崖、ADC 撞功耗。只有正交组合(ADC 质量 × DSP × FEC)才能从 33 dB 推到 44 dB。这套框架的价值,是把每个杠杆的 dB 贡献与代价量化摆出来——给的是一张"用什么组合、各花多少代价、能到多少 dB"的权衡表,而非一个是非题。 Deep LR is a full-stack problem; no single lever gets there. Each tops out at its own wall — DSP at the SNR wall, FEC at the pre-FEC cliff, ADC at power. Only the orthogonal combination (ADC quality × DSP × FEC) reaches from 33 to 44 dB. The framework's value is quantifying each lever's dB and cost — a trade table of "which combination, at what cost, reaches how many dB", not a yes/no answer.

贯穿始终的方法论Methodology throughout

  • 可证伪的指标——锁定用相位平稳性而非 PD 均值,眼高按真实符号分组而非阈值分组。数学上恒成立的指标测不出失败。Falsifiable metrics — lock by phase stationarity not PD-mean; eye height grouped by true symbol not threshold. A metric that always passes can't detect failure.
  • 先仿真再定论——PAM4 32G 上限、级联 FEC 增益,都是先跑数验证再写进包络/结论,不是拍脑袋定常数。Simulate before concluding — the PAM4 32G ceiling and the concat-FEC gain were run first, then written into the envelope, not set as guessed constants.
  • 诚实标注模型边界——30 GBd 硬顶代表未建模的电路墙;统计引擎的非 LTI 近似逐项标注并由时域交叉校验。Honest about model boundaries — the 30 GBd ceiling stands for unmodeled circuit walls; the statistical engine's non-LTI approximations are each flagged and cross-checked against the time engine.
  • bug 由逐层排查定位——jittered_zoh 的累计时移削平、MM-PD 极性、serdespy 端接混用,都是用物理数据而非猜测定位并修复。Bugs pinned by layer-by-layer tracing — the jittered_zoh clipping, MM-PD polarity, serdespy termination mixing were all located with physical data, not guesses.
